project.name: expo-template
project.description: An Android-first mobile app template built with Expo and React Native for Android app generation and Web preview in the current product flow

styling.note: NativeWind 4.2.1 supports Tailwind CSS v3 only and does not support v4

app.description: Main app directory using Expo Router file-based routing

layouts.description: Root layout with stack navigation and theming

rules: Files under app/ automatically become routes

scripts.reset-project: Reset the project and move sample code to the app-example directory

pathAliases.description: Use the @/ prefix to reference files from the project root

bestPractices: Use TypeScript types and avoid any
Keep components focused on a single responsibility for easier testing and reuse
Use NativeWind class names consistently for styling
Follow Expo Router file-based routing conventions
Prioritize consistency between the Android experience and the Web preview

codeOrganization.businessLogic: the matching route files under app/
codeOrganization.utilityFunctions: the utils/ directory, recommended to create if needed
codeOrganization.apiCode: the services/ or api/ directory, recommended to create if needed

notes: This project uses the React Native New Architecture, so verify dependency compatibility
This project enables React Compiler, so keep compiler-friendly patterns in mind
typedRoutes provides stronger route type hints
NativeWind 4.2.1 supports Tailwind CSS v3.x only, so do not upgrade to v4
NativeWind does not support every Tailwind CSS feature, so verify compatibility when styling
The current product flow supports Android app generation and Web preview only, so do not promise iOS delivery
This project supports pnpm only; keep package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml aligned to avoid runtime issues

Do not add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage by default; only introduce persistence dependencies when the user explicitly requests local storage and the dependency is confirmed compatible with the current Expo Android build flow
